purpose.zh: 拉伸后腿的髋前侧和大腿前侧
purpose.en: Stretch the front of the back leg's hip and thigh.

text.zh: 上身挺直，收紧臀部把髋往前送
text.en: Stay tall, squeeze your glutes, and ease your hips forward

text.zh: 后脚脚背搭在矮凳上，前脚踩稳，双手叉腰。
text.en: Rest the top of your back foot on the stool, front foot planted, hands on hips.

text.zh: 每次呼气再放松一点，别来回颠。
text.en: Each time you breathe out, relax a little deeper. No bouncing.

commonErrors.en: Arching your lower back instead of squeezing your glutes.

cautions.zh: 只拉到舒服的程度，疼就放松
cautions.en: Stretch only to a comfortable point, and ease off if anything hurts.

cautions.zh: 后膝下面垫软垫，膝盖不舒服就幅度小一点
cautions.en: Pad under your back knee, and move less if the knee feels uncomfortable.

changes: 动画每 8 秒一次「微前倾→挺直送髋-停-回来」，剂量从 30 秒保持改为每侧 2 组×4 次（rep_hold）
「骨盆后卷」改说法「收紧臀部把髋往前送」；名字去掉括号
补 cue「双手叉腰」（动画可见）
按用户决定改为静态保持计时，动画只作示意：45 秒×2 组/每侧，休息 15 秒；口令和要点改成进入—保持—呼气放松
